identity: Ordinary full-time Dutch-taught BSc Tandheelkunde, Groningen, RIO 56560, programme unit 1001O5915, registry row 225.
findings: The signed regulation was adopted 20 May 2026. Articles 3.6, 4.1 and 7.1 specify 180 EC, 10+9+10 components and 60 EC per year. The standard degree has no elective space, tracks or minor. The separate shortened route is excluded.

Article 9.3 requires first-year completion for Year 3 and specifies parallel Professional Skills prerequisites. Without the clinic, Year 3 entry additionally requires one Year 2 Professional Skills course, two of four Year 2 theory components and Scientific Skills 2. With the clinic it requires both skills courses, three theory components, Oral Healthcare in Context 2 and Scientific Skills 2. Article 3.7 requires relevant practical work before its examination.

The assessment plan distinguishes preclinical technical skills, supervised patient care in the 12 EC clinic, and an individual written thesis and oral defence or presentation within the 8 EC Scientific Skills 3 component. It lists examination, treatment planning, prevention and care among the clinic competencies. The three-year bachelor does not confer dentist qualification.
